name: Matthew of Aquasparta
biography: Follower of Bonaventura, more touched by the new Aristotelianism than his teacher; opposed Aquinas from an Augustinian standpoint while treating Aristotle as 'The Philosopher'; sought a middle way between Plato (wisdom without knowledge) and Aristotle (knowledge without wisdom).
